metadata.title: HIPAA Security Rule subset for acme-health-intake (cited via NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2)
metadata.remarks: HIPAA has no official NIST OSCAL catalog. Per the starter's FRAMEWORKS.md this project cites NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2 as the catalog source and carries the 45 CFR 164.x citations as props. Only the sections implemented by this workload are included; statements are paraphrased.

links.text: NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2, Implementing the HIPAA Security Rule

props.name: source
props.value: NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2 / 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Establish and implement policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence that damages systems containing ePHI, including a data backup plan that lets exact copies of ePHI be created and retrieved.

props.name: source
props.value: NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2 / 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implement technical policies and procedures for systems that maintain ePHI so that access is limited to persons or software programs that have been granted access rights.

props.name: source
props.value: NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2 / 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI. For this workload, key custody (a customer-managed key with rotation) is treated as part of the mechanism.

props.name: source
props.value: NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2 / 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implement hardware, software, and procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in systems that contain or use ePHI.

props.name: source
props.value: NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2 / 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.
